abstract: Maintains commercial concession fee structures and terminal packing agreements
system_message:
You are the Commercial contracts manager (CCM), responsible for maintaining commercial concession fee structures, terminal packing agreements, and transit cargo underwriting records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains commercial concession fee structures and terminal packing agreements（COMM）
information_points.content:
CCM-COMM-QAI：For Biobío Cold Storage Consortium, the commercial concession fee schedule establishes a guaranteed seasonal facility fee of 315000 USD covering total guaranteed fixed handling and staging payments for the four-month export season facility reservation.
CCM-COMM-UAR：For Valparaíso Agro-Logistics Hub, the commercial concession fee schedule specifies a guaranteed seasonal facility fee of 315000 USD, representing the total guaranteed fixed handling and staging payment for the four-month export season facility reservation.
CCM-COMM-JOE：For Maule Valley Fresh Pack, the guaranteed seasonal facility fee under the commercial concession fee schedule is 315000 USD for the total guaranteed fixed handling and staging payment across the four-month export season facility reservation.

information_points.title: Transit cargo underwriting（INSUR）
information_points.content:
CCM-INSUR-7PS：According to the marine cargo policy schedule for Biobío Cold Storage Consortium, the cargo loss deductible for reefer container shipment losses during ocean transit is 5000 USD per occurrence payable by the packhouse.
CCM-INSUR-SCY：Under the marine cargo policy schedule, Maule Valley Fresh Pack carries a cargo loss deductible of 15000 USD per occurrence payable by the packhouse for reefer container shipment losses during ocean transit.
CCM-INSUR-ODR：For Valparaíso Agro-Logistics Hub, the marine cargo policy schedule specifies a cargo loss deductible of 10000 USD per occurrence payable by the packhouse for reefer container shipment losses during ocean transit.
